algorithm.class_key: Boundary size and the least sorted local-family code over all 24 core permutations and all actual-boundary permutations. The original weight vector is excluded.
algorithm.geometry: Reduce every tile coordinate modulo n, merge equal generator sets, then keep generators meeting core {3,4,5,6}.
algorithm.name: exhaustive-core-boundary-canonicalization-v1
algorithm.numeric_proof_backend_independence: No arithmetic evaluator, Lean proof chunk layout or representative proof backend enters the orbit key, representative selection or point-map record.
algorithm.representative_selection: Prefer a pilot case; then choose the lowest period and the lowest original row index.
algorithm.weights: Keep the representative original vector and push it forward along each core bijection.

computational_validation.independent_replay: Rebuilds literal frozenset generators and actual supports. It does not import the producer or reuse its bit-mask canonicalization.
computational_validation.minimality_scope: The replay validates every proposed class identification and complete coverage. It does not independently prove that distinct representatives are nonisomorphic.

rejected_invalid_cases.reason: member 0: support map is not injective
representative 0: weights differ from the original successful vector

dependencies: Python standard library only. Original input provenance and Lean proof checks are separate.
formal_status: Untrusted candidate producer, data and witness replay. No complete numerical Lean batch or full span-four theorem is claimed by these files.

lean_interface.checker: transportCheck source.period source.entry target.period target.entry target.point_map
lean_interface.generic_interface_scope: The generic checker and illustrative transports have separate source/axiom/kernel receipts. These do not certify all records in this orbit file.
lean_interface.remaining_proof_work: Supply checked representative arithmetic and Lean proofs of every transportCheck and complete table coverage. The producer/replay results are never theorem premises.

entry.weights: Four transported alternative natural weights on sites 3,4,5,6; they may differ from the original row.
entry.word: The original seven letters at source_row.

member.point_map: List of [source_point,target_point] pairs, oriented representative to member and sorted by source point.

record_schema.member_coverage: Exactly all (period,row) pairs, ordered by increasing period and then original row. Representative cases are included and use identity support maps.
record_schema.point_map_domain: Exactly core union unionOf(localGenerators) of the representative. Keys occur once; values form the exact member support. No unused ambient points are serialized.

entry.weights: The original four natural-number weights at source_row, on sites 3,4,5,6.
entry.word: The original seven natural-number letters at source_row.

representative.id: Consecutive zero-based class ID in the representative array.
representative.pilot: Whether source_row belongs to the fixed 16-index pilot selection.

scope: The 9,088 original width-four successful words, each on its actual period-7, period-8 and period-9 ground. Each member receives transported alternative weights from one original successful representative.
